title: Lattice Quantum Chromodynamics for Quantum Simulations
summary: We develop a framework for quantum simulations of lattice SU($N_c$) gauge theory with quarks. Staggered and Wilson lattice fermions are considered in two and three spatial dimensions and a theta angle is included in three dimensions. The physical, gauge-invariant Hilbert space is formulated in a representation basis, where gauge and fermionic degrees of freedom are encoded by irreducible representations of SU($N_c$) that tensor at each lattice site to contain a singlet.
